commit.message:
Disable some node-exporter collector for metrics which are too verbose / unused

- softnet is absolutly unused
- netdev and netclass could be useful but only for real physical
  devices, while they collect everything for all devices, including
  virtual ones (and we can have many on these Docker machines) ; we should
  filter them at Alloy level, but it seems complex to implement with
  current Helm chart

commit.message:
Send metrics only for nodes and pods to save on Grafana cloud usage

Most kube-state-metrics metrics seems to be unused in our dashboards,
but they still count towards our usage. Sending data only for pods and
nodes seems to be sufficient. We could probably refine this a bit more,
but for now we lack proper reporting on usage
